cold_open: Jeff's 117.02 was the ninth-best Week 3 score in league history and would have beaten all eleven teams. The best quarterback performance of the week never started: Brian Clark benched Brock Purdy's 31.64 for Jalen Hurts's 8.31 and lost by 17.06.

notes.Brian Clark|Shawn: Clark left 41.08 points on his bench, the most in the league. Brock Purdy's 31.64 sat behind Jalen Hurts's 8.31, and that one swap wins it. Shawn has won two straight; Clark leads 20–14.
notes.Douglas|Steve Swanson: The week's narrowest win, by 6.12. Doug was projected to lose and beat his projection by 12.29. Steve had Michael Wilson's 15.95 on the bench behind Jaylen Waddle's 4.2. Series even, 10–10.
notes.Jeff|Kevin Swanson: Swanson scored 101.95, second-best in the league, and lost to the only team that topped it. Jeff went 27.43 over projection, led by Jahmyr Gibbs's 29.7. Swanson still leads the series 10–5.
notes.Eric|Thomas: The week's biggest blowout, 87.44–52.03. Eric's Drake Maye was projected for 15.07 and scored −1.12, the dud of the week. Tom has won two straight and takes a 5–4 lead.
notes.Evan|Fadi: Evan was projected for 84.58, more than Fadi, and scored 48.28: the week's low, 36.3 under projection, and short of all eleven other teams. Fadi has won two straight and leads 19–17.
notes.Dominic|Kevin O'Boyle: The luckiest win: Dominic's 74.41 was only eighth-best. O'Boyle had the quarterback of the week, Tyler Shough at 24.9, and Brock Bowers's 16.8 on the bench behind Dalton Schultz's 3.0. O'Boyle leads 16–14.

kicker: Dominic's team is called “I’ll take Kittle.” Jeff did: 19.1 points, the tight end of the week.
